title: BNPL Platinum: Late Fees, Due Dates, and How to Avoid Charges
summary: BNPL Platinum charges a fixed late fee when the minimum installment payment isn’t received by the installment due date shown in your account. The document explains how to avoid late charges (reminders, autopay ahead of time, confirming posted status, and validating payment-method changes) and what to do after a late fee is assessed.
